t0012-01.gloss: A courier's card sets a return after the access window.
t0012-01.rival_reading: A field-delivery schedule could run past a road restriction; the late return line does not identify who changed access.

t0012-02.gloss: A spray route and a crop-damage note share the same marked key.
t0012-02.rival_reading: A response crew could reroute through farm roads during a closure; wind damage might be ordinary field loss rather than a program failure.
